description: This file defines the code-behind class for the 'TakenCourses' page in an online examination system. It handles page load events and button click events that navigate to other pages such as Dashboard, UserProfile, Leaderboard, and LoginPage.

classes.name: TakenCourses
classes.description: Code-behind for the TakenCourses ASP.NET page, managing navigation through button click events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event. Currently does not perform any actions.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the home button, transferring control to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the profile button, transferring control to the UserProfile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the leaderboard button, transferring control to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Handles the click event for the logout button, transferring control to the LoginPage.
